definition{
  name: ordering_is_Equal,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,

    | CmpOrdering.Less => false
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => true
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => false)
}

definition{
  name: compare_Priority,
  parameters: [left : Priority, right : Priority],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | Priority.Low => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Priority.Normal => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Priority.Urgent => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)))
}

definition{
  name: compare_Nat,
  parameters: [left : Nat, right : Nat],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (if (left <? right) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Less) else (if (left =? right) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal) else (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))
}

definition{
  name: compare_TuplePriorityNat,
  parameters: [left : TuplePriorityNat, right : TuplePriorityNat],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match (compare_Priority (project left item0) (project right item0))
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_Nat (project left item1) (project right item1))
      | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
}

definition{
  name: inComfortBand,
  parameters: [reading : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let low : Nat := 18; (let high : Nat := 24; ((low <=? reading) && (reading <=? high))))
}

definition{
  name: pressing,
  parameters: [priority : Priority],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match priority
    | Priority.Low => false
    | Priority.Normal => false
    | Priority.Urgent => true)
}

definition{
  name: floors,
  parameters: [low : Nat, high : Nat],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (Prelude::natRange low (prim subtract high low : Nat))
}

definition{
  name: readingWithin,
  parameters: [reading : Nat, low : Nat, high : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((low <=? reading) && (reading <=? high))
}

definition{
  name: bookedOrFirstPart1,
  parameters: [fallbacks : (Option (List String))],
  result: (Option String),
  body: (match fallbacks
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [String])
    | Option.some tried2 => (prim index tried2 0 : (Option String)))
}

definition{
  name: bookedOrFirst,
  parameters: [booking : (Option String), fallbacks : (Option (List String))],
  result: (Option String),
  body: (match booking
    | Option.none => (bookedOrFirstPart1 fallbacks)
    | Option.some value1 => (ctor Option.some [String] value1))
}

definition{
  name: namedOrSpare,
  parameters: [named : (Option String), spare : (Option String)],
  result: (Option String),
  body: (match named
    | Option.none => spare
    | Option.some value1 => (ctor Option.some [String] value1))
}

definition{
  name: startsUnnamedPart1,
  parameters: [rooms : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match (prim index rooms 0 : (Option String))
    | Option.none => true
    | Option.some value1 => false)
}

definition{
  name: startsUnnamedPart2,
  parameters: [rooms : (List String)],
  result: String,
  body: (match (prim index rooms 0 : (Option String))
    | Option.none => ""
    | Option.some item1 => item1)
}

definition{
  name: startsUnnamed,
  parameters: [rooms : (List String)],
  result: Bool,
  body: (if (startsUnnamedPart1 rooms) then true else (prim equal (startsUnnamedPart2 rooms) "" : Bool))
}

definition{
  name: setPointGet1,
  parameters: [items1 : (List TupleTuplePriorityNatNat), needle1 : TuplePriorityNat],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match items1
    | List.nil => (ctor Option.none [Nat])
    | List.cons item1 rest1 => (if (ordering_is_Equal (compare_TuplePriorityNat (project item1 item0) needle1)) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] (project item1 item1)) else (setPointGet1 rest1 needle1))),
  recursive_argument: items1
}

definition{
  name: setPoint,
  parameters: [table : (List TupleTuplePriorityNatNat), priority : Priority, hour : Nat],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (setPointGet1 table (record TuplePriorityNat {item0 := priority, item1 := hour}))
}

definition{
  name: openingBand,
  parameters: [room : Room, target : Nat],
  result: Band,
  body: (record Band {low := (project room reading), high := target})
}

definition{
  name: modeFor,
  parameters: [coldArg : Bool, hot : Bool],
  result: Mode,
  body: (if coldArg then (if hot then (ctor Mode.Idle) else (ctor Mode.Heating)) else (if hot then (ctor Mode.Cooling) else (ctor Mode.Idle)))
}

definition{
  name: comfortablePart1,
  parameters: [low : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let t : Nat := low; ((18 <=? t) && (t <=? 24)))
}

definition{
  name: comfortablePart2,
  parameters: [high : Nat],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let t : Nat := high; ((18 <=? t) && (t <=? 24)))
}

definition{
  name: comfortable,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: Bool,
  body: (let low : Nat := (project band low); (let high : Nat := (project band high); ((comfortablePart1 low) && (comfortablePart2 high))))
}

definition{
  name: steady,
  parameters: [coldArg : Bool, hot : Bool, occupied : Bool],
  result: Bool,
  body: (if coldArg then (if occupied then false else true) else (if hot then (if occupied then false else true) else true))
}
